description: RDS master password as a string literal, with no characters outside the base64 charset
note: Sibling of rds-literal-password, which differs only by a trailing `!`. Together they isolate checkov's punctuation gap: the EntropyKeywordCombinator scores the value with detect-secrets' base64/hex entropy scanners, whose regex requires an unbroken charset run up to the closing quote. Same mechanism as the CKV_AWS_60 pair.
